1819.edj: 内湯と露天風呂のある気取らない温泉宿。朝食と夕食込み。

rv.t: Overall a comfortable stay. The private bath in the room was great, bed was comfy and the food was fantastic, but the public bath was quite small and has no view at all. Overall this ryokan lacks a view/ scenary, there isn't much in the neighborhood either. Having said that, it's quite close to the train station and it's easy to get by, it's also only a 2mins walk from the sea side (but we couldn't see it from our…

My wife took me here for my birthday in late 10/2023 and booked one of their private suites, which included a private, in-room dinner and breakfast, sauna, onsen, cold bath, bathroom, shower, relaxation room, and all-you-can-drink draft beer (until 9:30 PM). One word - AMAZING! Truly a once-in-a-lifetime experience. Everything was first class. You can even take a short walk to another facility on the beach and enjoy…

excellent kaiseki this evening @ kinokuniya ryokan on 30.11.2022 the sensai 前菜was good the awabi odoriyaki very good 👍🏻 the funamori (boat) sashimi - tako, tai, hamachi, maguro all very fresh & sweet kinmedai 金目鲷 was excellent very sweet & tasty ika sashimi & then odoriyaki was very good chiba wagyu I think it was oil yaki was excellent..very sweet tasty & very tender whatever doneness buri karaage ok only pork…

1820.aj: 〒321-1661 栃木県日光市 中禅寺湖
1820.ed: Scenic lake, discovered in 782, with summer hiking & boating, fall leaf watching & winter sports.
1820.edj: 782 年に発見されたと伝わる風光明媚な湖。夏にはハイキングとボート、秋には紅葉狩り、冬にはウィンター スポーツを楽しめる。

rv.t: After Nikko, we set off to Lake Chuzenji - which was lovely, but the more interesting sight was all of the Cherry Blossom that we saw. Being more north and so high up in the mountains, the last of the blossoms were still in bloom.

We visited april 23, cloudy day and thee lake had low water. Maybe the transision between winter and spring. No boats on the lake (because of low water level). The weather and season is a big factor. I think better skip if you plan to go like the same time we did. It was just ok. Maybe better in autumn with the autumn foilage. Even kegon falls had so little water.
Although it was raining when I was there, I still felt the serenity of the lake. Would love to go back here next time! I think it will be very pretty in autumn!

1821.a: Kegonno Falls, Chugushi, Nikko, Tochigi 321-1661, Japan
1821.aj: 〒321-1661 栃木県日光市中宮祠 華厳ノ滝

rv.t: number one waterfall in Japan we went on a cold windy day early April advantage is that there are no people and no lines you take an elevator 100 m to the bottom before you see the entire waterfall complex must be totally stunning in autumn the drive up and down require 25 hairpin turns one way though

Kegon no taki is famous as one of the most beautiful waterfalls in Japan. The view from the paid platform, which is accessed via 100 meters 100-meter-deep elevator, is spectacular. You can enjoy a cool spray from the waterfall. It's always crowded with foreign tourists.

We went to the observation deck and had a beautiful view of Kegonno Falls. There were a few school trips so it was crowded but still enough space for pictures. Be prepared to get a little wet from the waterfall’s mist (it’s a plus if it’s super hot out). There are 3 layers to the observation deck so plenty of viewpoints.

1822.a: Nikkō Tōshōgū, 2301 Sannai, Nikko, Tochigi 321-1431, Japan
1822.aj: 〒321-1431 栃木県日光市山内２３０１ 日光東照宮
1822.ed: Opulent 17th-century shrine complex honoring the first shogun & featuring colorful buildings & art.
1822.edj: 江戸幕府初代将軍を祀る 17 世紀の神社。色彩豊かな建物と芸術が見所。

rv.t: Nikkō Tōshōgū is one of Japan’s most spectacular and culturally significant shrines, where history, craftsmanship, and nature come together beautifully. The visit became even more memorable with an unexpected snowfall, creating a stunning contrast between the vibrant red shrine structures and the pure white snow covering the grounds. The colours of the elaborate decorations stood out even more against the…

This is the mausoleum of 德川家康 and is place to many important cultural treasures recognized as part of a heritage site. An admission ticket is required to enter. I recommend purchasing the combined ticket at Nikko Station in advance (it costs 1,600 yen per person and includes entry to both 東照宮 and 藥師堂). Visiting 東照宮 involves climbing quite a few stairs, but the architecture is absolutely stunning and filled with…

An amazing shrine surrounded by tall, towering trees, giving the whole place a very serene and grand atmosphere. It was raining during our visit, so we weren’t able to explore as much as we wanted. Still, the place felt majestic and impressive. It’s incredible how well it has been preserved over time — you can really feel its historical significance. Being a UNESCO World Heritage Site, it’s definitely worth visiting…

1823.a: Nikko Yubamaki ZEN, 1007 Kamihatsuishimachi, Nikko, Tochigi 321-1401, Japan
1823.aj: 〒321-1401 栃木県日光市上鉢石町１００７ 日光湯波巻き 全 - ZEN
catj: しゃぶしゃぶレストラン
1823.ed: Innovative Japanese dining, with a focus on presentation, in a chic, traditionally inspired space.
1823.edj: 和風創作料理の店。古民家風の落ち着いた店内で、盛り付けにこだわった料理を提供。

rv.t: This meal was an amazing interpretation of Nikko’s famous yuba tofu skin. Every course was so meticulously prepared and the staff explained each dish in detail (in Japanese). From beginning to end, through savory and sweet dishes, I was impressed. I was able to walk in as a solo traveler for dinner and be seated right away. If you are looking for a great dining experience and a unique take on yuba I highly recommend.

I dined here with prior notice of multiple allergies and the staff were helpful. The food was delicious! They were careful and the waitress explained to me what modifications the kitchen made to my dishes. It was raining heavily and upon request, staff were able to help us to hail a taxi -- they really went above and beyond.
Had an absolutely stellar yuba omakase. One of the chefs spoke really good English, service was polite and friendly. Everything tasted fresh and incredible, would highly recommend!

1824.ed: Hiking & cycling esplanade beside Lake Yamanaka, popular with photographers for views of Mount Fuji.
1824.edj: 写真家にも人気の富士山の景色を眺めながらハイキングやサイクリングが楽しめる山中湖沿いの遊歩道。

rv.t: Quite walk with great view to Fujisan. Quite windy so recommend to bring windproof jacket. Lighting in afternoon is not good for Fujisan shooting so recommend to visit in the morning. Easy to access via Fujisan bus loop but be mindful about the bus timetables as there’s only 1 bus per hour

Nice view of Fuji mountain but by the way, if you have to take F-Line Loop bus, the bus stop "Nagaike" has only 1 bus stand on clockwise. If you wanna go back to Kawaguchiko station, you have to wait at the traffic light that have sign of "Nagaike Bus stop" and wait quite long time. Please be patient. I wait for 1 hour already.

A beautiful lake near the magnificent Mt. Fuji. We came here in mid March, just after a light snow the night prior. The light snowcaped landscape and scenery made the already beautiful view of Mt. Fuji even more charming. A casual stroll along the lake was so relaxing.

1825.a: Numazu Gotetsu, 121-2 Senbonminatocho, Numazu, Shizuoka 410-0845, Japan
1825.aj: 〒410-0845 静岡県沼津市千本港町１２１−２ 海鮮丼専門 五鉃沼津本店
1825.ed: Straightforward restaurant whipping up seafood donburi in a rustic, laid-back space.
1825.edj: シンプルな海鮮丼屋。店内は素朴で居心地の良い雰囲気。

rv.t: Amazing seafood and extremely fresh! Had the uni bowl and the normal chirashi. Both were extremely tasty and super fresh had the oysters as well with the ponzu sauce do get there early as the queue gets rather long but well worth it and at the end you can put the dashi to make it a be try nice portage style with sashimi pretty much!

Lovely family run store opened since 50 years ago. A must go place if you love fresh seafood. Their choice of fresh fish is unbelievable and they are very generous in their portions. All the cooks are baby boomers with gen z waiters indicating a continuance of their tradition and heritage. Walking in make you feel you walked into the past.

Well known for its 5 assorted mixed don. We chose the don with 4 kinds of ingredients, crab meat, assorted fish, shrimp and ikura, over warm rice. Most of ingredients tasted fresh, except the shrimp, though quite large, was a bit fishy. They also provided dashi soup to be poured over half of the don to give it a different style. The soup was flavorful, but I preferred the dry style.

1826.edj: 海を一望する高級温泉宿。レストランあり。屋上にインフィニティ風呂のある大浴場を併設。

rv.t: nothing really made me feel like a 5 star hotel here…. disappointed stay…. only the roof top ocean is probably gonna make up part of the price I paid. room was really dated compared to other 4 star hotels I have stayed in the area, they don’t even have window screens to block the bugs at night from flying into our room, amenities are dated, meal was not bad but nothing surprising or special except the sashimi boat…

I had a very pleasant stay at Hamanoyu. The ryokan offers a peaceful and traditional Japanese atmosphere, perfect for a relaxing getaway. My room was spacious, clean, and beautifully maintained. The onsen facilities were excellent, providing a very soothing experience. Dinner and breakfast were highlights of the stay, featuring carefully prepared seasonal dishes that were both delicious and beautifully presented…

One of the best experiences I have had in my life. The room was exceptional. So warm and inviting, amazing decor and a real authentic Japanese vibe. Outdoor private Onsen. Fabulous and very hot! Totally luxury and comfort. In room dining was brought served by the lovely Mao-san. She was gracious and fantastic throughout the meal. The sashimi and sea bream were outstanding. The Wagyu beef was next level. Add in a…

1827.a: Ningle Terrace, Nakagoryo, Furano, Hokkaido 076-8511, Japan
1827.aj: 〒076-8511 北海道富良野市中御料ニングルテラス
1827.ed: Picturesque timber cottages & workshops in the woods showcasing & selling traditional handicrafts.
1827.edj: 森の中の美しいログハウスで、伝統的な手工芸品の展示と販売を行なっている。ワークショップも開催。

rv.t: This time I came on July 5th noon time, it is cool under the trees and shades. The log houses are unique and they sell mani kind of souvenirs also some nice cafes are there. Visit in winter time is different and more magical especially during the light up. If you are visiting In summer don’t miss the outdoor activities in the tree adventure furano!

Ningle Terrace is an absolute beautiful place! It felt like stepping straight into a woodland fairy tale. The illuminated log cabins and winding wooden pathways nestled in the forest create such an enchanting atmosphere— my daughter was completely captivated by the whole experience. My wife and I really enjoyed taking a relaxing stroll under the trees and browsing the unique, handcrafted artisan goods in each little…

Ningle Terrace is a charming, fairy-tale-like shopping village nestled within a forest in Furano, Hokkaido. Located beside the New Furano Prince Hotel, it features a collection of small wooden cottages connected by scenic boardwalks, each housing unique artisan shops. ￼ What makes it truly special is its atmosphere. Surrounded by tall pine trees and natural landscapes, the terrace blends art, nature, and…

1828.a: Biei Forest KONON Cafe & Stay, 村山 Omura, Biei, Kamikawa District, Hokkaido 071-0218, Japan
1828.aj: 〒071-0218 北海道上川郡美瑛町大村村山 美瑛の森 KONON cafe & stay
1828.ed: People say this cafe offers delicious coffee, homemade pastries, and parfaits, all crafted with high-quality, locally sourced ingredients. They also highlight the peaceful, intimate atmosphere, enhanced by curated music and beautiful views of the surrounding forest. Guests mention the management's warm hospitality and the unique experience of having the cafe to themselves due to the…
1828.edj: このカフェを利用した人は、高品質な地元食材を使ったおいしいコーヒー、手作りの焼き菓子、パフェを高く評価しています。また、厳選された音楽と周囲の森の美しい景色が、穏やかで落ち着いた雰囲気をさらに引き立てているようです。予約制のため、カフェを貸し切りにできる特別な体験や、オーナーの温かいおもてなしも好評です。

rv.t: Felt like I stepped into another world in this cafe, and I really appreciate that it is by reservation only - really maintains the intended peace and calmness of the forest space. Would not want a crowd of tourists freely flooding this beautiful place. We could enjoy the blueberry bakes and drinks in peace, there is no where else you can find such a cosy and private dining atmosphere in Hokkaido!🌲The owner is very…

Konon Cafe is truly a hidden gem in the forest. I’m so happy I discovered it. The café offers a beautiful view of the trees, snow, and birds, creating a peaceful and magical atmosphere. Since it operates by reservation only, you get to enjoy the entire place to yourself, which makes the experience even more special and intimate. The service was also excellent.

The owner curated a wonderful atmosphere and experience with Konon cafe. Because a reservation is required and only one party is served at a time, you are expected to order both a drink and a homemade pastry/parfait. Don't worry though because no matter what you choose, it will be high quality and you will be able to enjoy it. If you come with a mindset of respect for the work that went into this cafe, you will…

1829.a: Christmas tree, Bibaushi, Biei, Kamikawa District, Hokkaido 071-0471, Japan
1829.aj: 〒071-0471 北海道上川郡美瑛町美馬牛クリスマスツリーの木
1829.ed: Visitors say this tree offers a beautiful, picturesque landscape, especially when surrounded by snow, creating a peaceful and magical atmosphere. They also highlight that it's a great spot for photography, with ample space to capture photos without being blocked by others. Guests mention that staff are present to help guide parking and traffic, making the experience smoother.
1829.edj: この木を訪れたユーザーのクチコミでは、特に雪に囲まれた景色が美しく、絵のように美しい風景だと評価されています。静かで幻想的な雰囲気が味わえるようです。また、写真撮影に最適な場所で、他の人に遮られることなく広々とした空間で撮影できるという声もあります。駐車場や交通整理のためにスタッフが常駐しており、スムーズに利用できるという感想も寄せられています。

rv.t: The Biei Christmas Tree is a simple yet incredibly beautiful photo spot, especially during winter. A single tree standing alone in a vast snowy field creates a peaceful and almost surreal atmosphere. When covered in snow, the scenery feels like a postcard — clean, quiet, and truly magical. There’s nothing much to do here, but that’s exactly why it’s special. It’s a place to pause, take photos, and fully enjoy the…

Visited during the last light of the day, almost missed it — but totally worth it. A lonely tree standing quietly in the snow, peaceful and beautifully minimal. Simple, yet somehow everyone stops to take a photo. Highly recommend coming in the late afternoon for the best light and winter atmosphere ❄️ #Hokkaido #ChristmasTree #LonelyTree #WinterInJapan

I didn’t have high expectations before visiting the “Lonely Christmas Tree” in Hokkaido — I was simply curious to see what made it special. In reality, the tree itself is quite simple. But in winter, surrounded by snow, it creates a very poetic and calming atmosphere. If you have time, it’s worth stopping by. You’ll probably capture a photo you’ll really love. In the snowy landscape the tree looks especially…

1830.a: Shirogane Blue Pond (Aoiike), Shirogane, Biei, Kamikawa District, Hokkaido 071-0235, Japan
1830.aj: 〒071-0235 北海道上川郡美瑛町白金白金青い池
1830.ed: Reachable by a short hike, this manmade pond draws nature lovers for its blue hue & tranquility.
1830.edj: 静寂に包まれた青い水が自然愛好家を魅了する人造池。駐車場から徒歩でアクセス可能。

rv.t: Visiting Shirogane Blue Pond (Aoiike) in Biei during our summer road trip across Hokkaido was an absolute bucket-list moment that surpassed every single expectation we had from seeing photos online. Located just a short drive from the nearby Shirahige Waterfall, pulling into the spacious and remarkably well-managed parking area was completely effortless, allowing us to hit the flat, tree-lined walking trail within…

Be Careful of the carpark entry ticket fee. If you enter wrongly your ticket is 1000yen instead of 300yen. Remember to exchange at the entrance before paying. It’s a nice sight but full of tourist and probably 15mins will be enough. It’s very small, suggest you turn left, then walk all the way back towards right and end back at carpark. Proceed driving further up to waterfall.

Shirogane Blue Pond is famous for its unique turquoise blue water and peaceful atmosphere. The standing dead trees in the pond create a distinctive and photogenic view that changes with the seasons. It’s conveniently located and very close to the main area, making it easy to visit. The walking paths are well maintained and perfect for taking photos. A worthwhile stop when visiting Biei. 💙

1831.a: LeTao Canal Plaza Store, 2 Chome-1-20 Ironai, Otaru, Hokkaido 047-0031, Japan
1831.aj: 〒047-0031 北海道小樽市色内２丁目１−２０ ルタオ運河プラザ店
catj: デザート ショップ
1831.ed: Diners like this cafe's delicious cheesecakes, parfaits, and soft-serve ice cream, with many highlighting the "Toro-Toro Nama Short" cake and exclusive items. They also appreciate the friendly and welcoming staff, as well as the spacious and cozy atmosphere. Guests mention the convenient location for a break and the extended evening hours for the cafe and bar.
1831.edj: クチコミによると、このカフェの美味しいチーズケーキ、パフェ、ソフトクリームは多くの人に好評で、特に「とろとろ生ショート」ケーキや限定品を挙げる人が多くいます。また、親しみやすく丁寧なスタッフや、広々として居心地の良い雰囲気も高く評価されています。休憩に便利な立地や、カフェとバーの夜間営業時間の長さも喜ばれています。

rv.t: This was my first time visiting, and there was a staff member outside handing out samples when we arrived. They were featuring a new seasonal melon flavor, which my husband absolutely loved. My favorite was the famous double fromage cheesecake. The store is divided into a few sections. There’s a counter where you can order soft-serve ice cream and takeout items, a café with desserts and a food menu, and a gift shop…

LeTAO Canal Plaza Store One of Hokkaido's most famous dessert brands, located inside a beautifully renovated historic building near Otaru Canal. The charming atmosphere blends the character of Otaru's old architecture with the elegance of a modern dessert shop. It's a great place to stop by for souvenirs, especially LeTAO's signature cheesecakes and sweet treats. Visitors can also relax and enjoy desserts and drinks…

THE BEST ICE CREAM- MARRIAGE!!! You must try it when you are visiting Otaru. Most people talk about the milk ice cream but this brand created the cheese and milk together, perfect combination! I couldn’t find it anywhere else.

1832.a: Ramen Shingen Hanakawa Honten, 1 Chome-78 Hanakawa Minami 1 Jo, Ishikari, Hokkaido 061-3201, Japan
1832.aj: 〒061-3201 北海道石狩市花川南１条１丁目７８ らーめん信玄 花川本店
1832.ed: Reviewers praise this ramen shop for its delicious and rich miso ramen featuring flavorful noodles and tender chashu, complemented by a satisfying mini chashu rice bowl. Customers also appreciate the spacious parking and the clean, expansive interior. Some reviews mention the service can be inattentive.
1832.edj: クチコミでは、このラーメン店は、風味豊かな麺と柔らかいチャーシューが特徴の、美味しくて濃厚な味噌ラーメンが高い評価を得ています。また、満足感のあるミニチャーシュー丼も好評です。広々とした駐車場と清潔で広い店内も、利用した人から喜ばれています。 一方で、店員の対応が行き届いていないという声も一部で聞かれます。

rv.t: Shingen Hanakawa Main Store This is the kind of restaurant that’s mainly loved by locals, but it’s so incredibly good that I genuinely think travelers should make the effort to visit. I ordered the Koku Miso Ramen and the Mini Chashu Rice Bowl. The miso broth doesn’t rely on bold flavors like chili or garlic. Instead, it’s wonderfully balanced, and from the very first sip you can taste its deep, rich umami. The…

We came here about 11:45-ish, just right before the peak of lunch hours and we were lucky there was just one spot open to park our car. There's a waiting list when you go into the place. Best not come here by car on peak hours since there's very limited parking space. Some reviews say it's no longer crowded from 2pm onwards. Food was great, their menu was only in japanese. Their shinshuu(miso ramen) is mostly…
Thank you!! Great service- we came with a baby and only speaking English, every restaurant’s worst nightmare lol. Staff was so friendly and gracious!! Great food!

rv.t: We chose Sun Siyam Iru Veli for our honeymoon, and it was truly an unforgettable experience. A very special thanks to Sharyaan Firag, who welcomed us warmly and took excellent care of us throughout our stay. He arranged all of our reservations promptly and was always there whenever we needed assistance. His kindness, professionalism, and attention to detail made us feel genuinely valued. All the activities we joined…

Sun Siyam Iru Veli Maldives made for one of the best resort stays I’ve had so far. The location is excellent, with a beautiful reef around the island that is perfect for snorkeling. The whole property was very well maintained, and the rooms were clean, comfortable, and thoughtfully kept. From the moment we arrived, everything felt smooth and well organized, starting with the pickup from Malé International Airport…

This place is paradise. From the moment we arrived, the resort’s staff welcomed us with genuine warmth, making us feel instantly at ease in this tropical paradise. The overwater villa was a dream—spacious, elegantly designed, and offering direct access to the crystal - clear sea water. I love the food those chef cooked, especially the lobster barbecue. And thanks Fauzaan for upgrading our room, that is unexpected…

1834.a: Japan, 〒907-1101 Okinawa, Yaeyama District, Taketomi, 441 JUICE BOX
1834.aj: 〒907-1101 沖縄県八重山郡竹富町竹富４４１ JUICE BOX

観光センターの入り口横にあるキッチンカーです 豊富なドリンクと沖縄らしい軽食があります(塩サーターアンダギー、スパムおにぎり、オニササ) お酒の種類が豊富です ソフトドリンクもたくさんあります 特にオススメしたいのはフルーツを使ったドリンクです 私たちはパインスムージーをいただきました パイナップルがとても美味しいスムージーでした ナチュラルなのでお子さんにも安心して与えられると思います 支払い方法も豊富で便利です 水牛車や送迎バスへの持ち込みはできないので注意しましょう

1835.a: HIMAWARI WORKS Sunflower Bike Rental, 815 Taketomi, Yaeyama District, Okinawa 907-1101, Japan
1835.aj: 〒907-1101 沖縄県八重山郡竹富町竹富８１５ HIMAWARI WORKS・ひまわりレンタサイクル・竹富島ウォークツアー
catj: 自転車レンタル サービス

rv.t: An unexpected oasis in the middle of the island. We were on the beach and hungry for a little treat and ran into this gem on the side of the road. Delicious! The shaved ice work soft cream topping was great, and I had some soft cream with caramel and peanut toppings. I don't know when or if we'll return to Taketomi Island, but we'll come back here if we do.
I rented a bicycle at Himawari near Izumiya Inn. Shaved ice with Mango icecream was my favorite sweets there. Noted on my wonder-tips site.
近くにある小浜荘で宿泊したら、レンタルサイクルを持ってきてくれると聞いたので自転車を借りました。しかもお店に行けばカキ氷を無料でいただけると聞き店舗にもおじゃましました。集落の外れにあるので、少し探しましたが黄色い旗ですぐにわかると思います。また竹富に行った時はお世話になると思います。

1836.a: Japan, 〒907-0023 Okinawa, Ishigaki, 1-1 島そば一番地
1836.aj: 〒907-0023 沖縄県石垣市石垣１−１ 島そば一番地
1836.ed: Compact outfit with a neighborhood vibe specializing in soba noodle soup with pork broth.
1836.edj: 庶民的な雰囲気のこぢんまりとした店。豚骨ベースのスープを使用した八重山そばを味わえる。

rv.t: Very tasty local dishes! Highly recommended!! Comforting food, warm atmosphere, very welcoming. Aside of the great noodles and tender meat, the broth is divine! We've been here five years ago and very happy to return again today.

We came here because the place got like 300plus reviews. Maybe its just me, I didnt feel the spark. The broth is quite silky however the bone was still hard. I wish they could cook the ribs a bit longer? The taste also rather light, like too light for us to appreciate it. We had better soba in other places..
Nice, small local place, friendly staff. Various noodle dishes (soba). Try their sea grapes appetizer, they are delicious.

1836.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 10:30

1837.aj: キューケンホフ公園 Stationsweg 166A, 2161 AM Lisse, オランダ
1837.ed: Expansive, 19th-century park, open from March to May, showcasing multicolored Dutch spring flowers.
1837.edj: 19 世紀に造られた広大な公園。3～5 月に公開されている。色彩豊かなオランダの春の花々を見ることができる。

rv.t: This place is an absolute must-visit! Keukenhof Gardens is breathtakingly beautiful. We went toward the end of the season and were still blown away by how stunning everything looked—the tulips, the landscapes, and the overall atmosphere were magical. We took the Qbuzz bus from Amsterdam RAI station, which included garden admission and flexible return transportation. The entire experience was seamless and hassle-free…

We visited Keukenhof near the end of the blooming season after hearing countless comments like “you missed peak season” and “most of the displays are already fading.” While some displays were no longer at their peak, the beauty, atmosphere, and overall experience still far exceeded our expectations. What we found was a breathtaking and deeply transportive experience. The gardens are beautifully designed with winding…

We absolutely loved visiting Keukenhof Gardens. The gardens are enormous and truly stunning. There was so much variety — different types of flowers, beautiful plants, and unique displays throughout the park. Every area felt different and there was always something new to see. We visited on a Wednesday and were surprised by how crowded it already was, so I can only imagine how busy weekends can get. I would…

1838.aj: StoryTiles, Singel 410, 1016 AS Amsterdam, オランダ

rv.t: A lovely store with a delightful host and an impressive selection of whimsical metal tile holders, with frames and wooden stands. Hard to pick from the wide array of cute designs. The tiles make a fantastic present and the classy gift wrapping is complimentary, but are quite expensive. It's inaccurate to consider hand-painted, because they're prints. It's a nice option to have them customized with personalized…

The store is nice and I like they are trying to add more designs and colours to the dutch blue tile techniques. They claim that all their tiles are hand made. However some of the designs seemed like printed to us as they were way too fine for human hand. Also the prices for the tiles are quite high. For that price you could get actual tiles from the original factory in Delft.

The StoryTiles Store in Amsterdam is a must-visit for unique, handmade tiles that tell a story. From whimsical illustrations of Dutch landmarks to quirky depictions of everyday life, each tile is a work of art. You can even customize your own tiles for a special event or occasion. The store's talented artisans will work with you to create a one-of-a-kind tile that will make your gift truly special. As a customer, I…

1839.a: Kauf Dich Glücklich Amsterdam, Raadhuisstraat 40, 1016 DG Amsterdam, Netherlands
1839.aj: Kauf Dich Glücklich Amsterdam, Raadhuisstraat 40, 1016 DG Amsterdam, オランダ

rv.t: Amazing store with amazing employees. I was exploring Amsterdam on my last days there and came across this gem of a store. I used to live in Berlin and never got to know the shop there. The employees here are so friendly and welcoming. I bought a bag and then I ended up in the neighbourhood again the next day and bought a shirt here too. I wish we had this store in Canada!
very good , quality clothes (i have a lot from there) . Slow fashion 🤎✨

I absolutely loved this store. Bought two really adorable dresses to bring back to California. I wish I could order online from them too. The staff was also very cool. I want to know their music playlist. It was on point!

1839.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 10:00

1840.aj: Fabel Friet Runstraat, Runstraat 1, 1016 GJ Amsterdam, オランダ
catj: ファースト フード店
1840.ed: Relaxed outpost producing fried potatoes & croquettes, plus locally sourced & homemade toppings.

rv.t: Fabel Friet absolutely lived up to the hype! The fries were perfectly crispy on the outside and soft and fluffy on the inside. We tried the famous truffle mayonnaise with freshly grated Parmesan, and the combination was incredible—rich, flavorful, and unlike any fries I’ve had before. Despite the long queue, the service was quick and well organized, so the wait was definitely worth it. The ingredients tasted fresh…

Fabel Friet serves up delicious, crispy fries that are full of flavor. We tried ours with the mozzarella topping, and they were fantastic. The wait was only about 10 minutes, including the time it took to get them ready. It’s a take-out-only spot, so it is best to grab your order and find a nice place nearby along the canals to enjoy them. One portion is quite generous and was plenty for two people to share…

The service was fast and well organized. Even though there was a long line, we only waited about five minutes, which was impressive. The fries were tasty, and the combination of truffle mayonnaise and Parmesan cheese was definitely the highlight. It gives the fries a unique and delicious flavor. The only downside for me was the price. €7+ feels a bit expensive for fries. Overall, I enjoyed them, but I don't think…

1840.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00

rv.t: We stopped by Breadwinner Jordaan for a quick bite and really enjoyed it. We had the BLT bagel and the cream cheese bagel—both were fresh, generously filled, and very tasty. The service was friendly and efficient. It’s a very small place, with seating limited to a bench outside and a few stools, so it’s best suited for a quick stop rather than a long meal. Overall, a great spot for a fresh bagel and a quick lunch…

Craving fresh sourdough bagels in Amsterdam? Breadwinner is an absolute must-visit. Their bagels are hand-rolled, slowly fermented, and baked in stone ovens, giving them that perfect chewy inside with a crisp, golden outside. I went for the everything bagel with smoked salmon, cream cheese, and red onion, and it was incredible! Every bite was packed with flavor, the cream cheese was super creamy, and the salmon…
Amazing bagel with avocado, cream cheese lettuces and tomato. Bagels were warm and fresh. Definitely one of the best i have had in Amsterdam. I just wish you all had fresh juices!

1842.ed: Gourmet shortbread cookies retailer offering Hawaiian-inspired flavors such as mango & macadamia.

rv.t: Honolulu Cookie Company Ala Moana Center is one of my favorite stops at Ala Moana Center. Conveniently located right at the entrance to the Makai Food Court, it’s impossible to miss. The moment you pause to browse, the cheerful staff warmly greet you with bright smiles, creating a welcoming atmosphere every time. The delicious sweet aroma drifting from the store is absolutely irresistible and always draws me in…

Visited one of the OG Hawaiian shortbread stores today. They are conveniently in the bottom food court (not the mauka or lanai one I think, it has Sees nextdoor). It's also nice that they have kiosks on both side of the booth to check you out even though it can get busy at times. Definitely go the route of getting one of the boxes and filling it with specified amounts. It's cheaper than paying by the piece. Oh also…

These shortbread cookies are insane! I love shortbread and was really blown away by the flavor of these cookies. The shops are everywhere and it’s absolutely a must stop if you love shortbread. Truly some of the best shortbread I have ever had. There is something very special about these cookies. Hoping they ship!! The staff were all so sweet and fun to talk to also.

1843.a: IL Gelato Hyatt Waikiki, Hyatt Regency, 2424 Kalākaua Ave 205 1st Floor, Honolulu, HI 96815
1843.aj: IL Gelato Hyatt Waikiki, Hyatt Regency, 2424 Kalākaua Ave 205 1st Floor, Honolulu, HI 96815 アメリカ合衆国
catj: コーヒーショップ・喫茶店
1843.ed: Dessert hub crafting gelato in traditional Italian & Hawaiian flavors, plus paninis & waffles.

rv.t: If you're in the mood for gelato I highly recommend this place! It's a stand located in the hotel on the ground floor. Definitely check out the various samples to make your decision but honestly you can't go wrong. I think the fruit flavored gelatos are the best though and most refreshing after a day at the beach but the chocolate and other dessert flavors are delicious too.

Great little ice cream spot! They have a wide variety of flavors to choose from — from classic vanilla and chocolate to tropical fruit and fun seasonal options. Everything tastes fresh and flavorful! What I really liked is that they also offer smoothie-style ice cream and milkshakes, which are super refreshing, especially on a warm day. The prices are very reasonable, and portion sizes are generous. Perfect place to…
Simple and tasty. The açaí bowl wasn’t too sweet, loved it. Good portion to share between two people.

1844.a: 〒96815 Hawaii, Honolulu, Seaside Ave, Aloha Steak House
1844.aj: アメリカ合衆国 〒96815 Hawaii, Honolulu, Seaside Ave, Aloha Steak House
1844.ed: Casual fine dining on steaks, seafood & Hawaiian dishes with beer, floats & tropical cocktails.
1844.edj: 気取らない雰囲気の高級レストラン。ビール、フロート、トロピカル カクテルとともにステーキやシーフード、ハワイ料理を味わえる。

rv.t: Had a great experience at Aloha Steakhouse. The steak was cooked exactly right with a solid sear and came out hot on the cast iron. We had the tomahawk but also saw a few others get excellent steaks. The asparagus and Caesar salad were both on point—and the garlic shrimp was awesome, light and crispy without being greasy. What stood out most was the service— our server Kula was awesome. Attentive, well-timed, and…

Izaiah was awesome and made our first experience there great! Also, shout out to the bartender who gave me a new napkin when the wind blew mine to the ground and almost grabbed my receipt when wind got me again. Top tier service team!! Food was really delicious. Bone in Paniolo Ribeye was perfectly cooked and we really enjoyed that with the twin lobster tails. My favorite though was the dessert. Kona Coffee Creme…

Great steakhouse off of Seaside Avenue! Our waiter, Kula, was very knowledgeable and offered several great suggestions such as a passion fruit lava flow and getting every last piece of steak off of our tomahawk. Everybody was very nice. I’d recommend getting earlier reservations to ensure you get the steak you’d like. We happened to order the last 30 oz tomahawk of the evening. The twice baked potato (especially…

1845.ed: Shrimp recipes & hefty, international dishes offered in a tiny, informal eatery with a courtyard.

rv.t: Easily one of our favorite meals in Waikiki. Great if you’re looking for something casual. Plenty of garlic on our shrimp and appreciate they were all peeled in advance without requiring us to peel ourselves like other restaurants. Highly recommend!

Compared to Jenny’s Shrimp Truck in the North Shore, this tastes like the shrimp and garlic sauce were cooked separately then tossed together at the end. The garlic is sharp (perhaps simmer it for longer) and the shrimp tastes unseasoned if you get a bite with no sauce. The white rice could use some furikake. The Thai shrimp curry plate (choice of spicy or not) was actually better, I would come back for that…

We originally found Ebinomi on YouTube as a “better than North Shore shrimp” type recommendation, and honestly, it was a great find — especially because it’s right in Waikiki. For GF notes: the garlic shrimp is sautéed, not deep fried. No mac salad cross-contamination issue there, though they do have fried items in the kitchen, so use your own judgment depending on your sensitivity level. My wife is gluten…

1845.stj: 営業中 · 営業終了: 15:00 · 再開時間: 17:00

1846.a: Duke's Waikiki, 2335 Kalākaua Ave #116, Honolulu, HI 96815
1846.aj: デュークス ワイキキ 2335 Kalākaua Ave #116, Honolulu, HI 96815 アメリカ合衆国
catj: シーフード・海鮮料理店
1846.ed: Popular option known for its beachfront location, surf 'n' turf, tiki vibe & umbrella drinks.
1846.edj: シーフードとステーキ、ポリネシア風の雰囲気、ビーチカクテルを楽しめる海辺の人気店。

rv.t: Great views and atmosphere. Excellent buffet lunch if you are into buffets. Price was just over $30 for the buffet. It had shrimp but not coconut shrimp so I had the burger and fries. The pulled pork nachos were excellent according to other family members who had most of the toppings put into a bowl on the side. The fish and chips was also rated highly by family members. The portion were ample. The Mai Tai was also…

Came here for drinks only. It was super busy but overall it was a good time. Came back to try the food and I had to come back another time after that! Lol the food is so good! I love the live music while dining. The first time I visited, I didn't really hangout in the dining area because it was too crowded. The other times I have had the dine in experience and it was a good time. The servers are super friendly and…

We LOVED Dukes!!!! Totally understand why there’s queues everyday. An absolute vibe & very lively inside. It’s also facing the ocean. More importantly the food was yummy. Loved the fish it was so juicy. Same with the chicken - well portioned too. Can’t say no to the hula pie heheee, btw it’s huge. We actually did a walk in & was told that it would be approx an hour but got our table around 30-40 mins

1847.a: Off the Hook Poke Market, 2908 E Manoa Rd, Honolulu, HI 96822
1847.aj: オフ ザ フック ポケ マーケット 2908 E Manoa Rd, Honolulu, HI 96822 アメリカ合衆国
1847.ed: People say this poke market offers fresh, high-quality fish with delicious and varied flavor options, including spicy ahi and ginger ahi. They also highlight the tasty sushi rice and generous portions. Visitors appreciate the quick service, friendly staff, and convenient free parking across the street.

rv.t: I don’t recommend this place at all. It’s really not worth the wait or the hype. I had the mini bowl with shoyu ahi and wasabi furikake. The poke is so salty I couldn’t finish the mini bowl because the sauces were too strong. It really felt like I was drinking soy sauce. I was so thirty after eating the few bites I was chugging water. I went at 3pm when there wasn’t a line but the rice was already prepped and left…

This is a terrific poke stop. They have small and regular containers. Our group had Hawaiian style Ahi (contains Limu), Spicy Ahi and Kilauea Fire. The tuna is fresh, fresh, fresh. Service was impeccable and staff was well coordinated to handle our order and get us on our way. We were fortunate and walked up with only one person in line so wait time was short. This a take-out eatery so no dine-in.

Fast, incredible fish & sauces, friendly! Got this rec'd by a friend and it did not disappoint! Loved the wasabi furikake & spicy ahi. I came around 1pm and it was quick but I bet it's busier at peak lunchtime a they're fast anyway though! I got the mini and it was so filling - perfect for lunch! Free parking across the street by safeway

1848.a: Dole Plantation, 64-1550 Kamehameha Hwy, Wahiawa, HI 96786
1848.aj: ドール・プランテーション 64-1550 Kamehameha Hwy, Wahiawa, HI 96786 アメリカ合衆国
1848.ed: This historic pineapple plantation now attracts families with a train ride & a 3-acre garden maze.
1848.edj: 歴史あるパイナップル農園。機関車での園内巡りが家族連れに人気。12,140 平方メートルの規模の屋外迷路も楽しめる。

rv.t: We booked the plantation tour in advance and really enjoyed the experience. The mini-train takes you around the plantation while explaining the history of the site, how pineapples are planted and harvested, and the different fruits and crops grown there. There’s also a beautiful garden to explore, with lots of different flowers and plants. As you walk through, you can listen to audio guides at different points to…

I did this with Viator round trip transportation from Waikiki (highly recommend). I personally liked the train because I got some history and saw a variety of plants. I didn’t care for the garden. You can see pineapples without doing the garden and garden is small. Dole whip was basic. If you’ve had it at Disney don’t expect anything special. I wish they had more history information on the true history of the…

Great experience. The train is a fun and comfortable experience for families with children of all ages. Great break from midday sun and too much heat. The gardens were the best part. Truly gorgeous landscaping with a stunning variety of flowers and local plant life. The Gift Shop is a little overwhelming and having multiple vendors with their own registers got confusing at times. The store could use more defined…

1849.a: Diamond Head State Monument, Honolulu, HI 96815
1849.aj: Diamond Head State Monument, Honolulu, HI 96815 アメリカ合衆国
1849.ed: A trail leads visitors to the summit of this volcanic tuff cone & former fort with panoramic views.
1849.edj: 見晴らしのよい旧軍事要塞の火砕丘。頂上までの遊歩道がある。

rv.t: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ An absolute must-see when visiting Waikiki! Just a heads-up for out-of-state folks: you must have a reservation, so make sure to book yours online before heading over. I highly recommend grabbing a slot for sunrise—it is hands down the best time to experience this trail. Don't underestimate the trek, as it is not an easy hike! Bring plenty of water, wear good shoes, and be ready for some serious steep climbs…

Beautiful hike that's definitely a workout. Well worth it when you get to the top. You actually drive into a tunnel at one end of the volcano and parking inside and hike within the caldera to the top. It's got everything from gravel to rocky pathways carved along the way to cement steps to tunnels and an old iron spiral stairway that let's you out inside a cement bunker or pillbox that was a WW2 lookout that still…

Totally worth it! I would recommend making a reservation and getting a parking spot. The walk is uphill and can be hot and very sunny so bring sunblock, water, and appropriate clothing. Eventually you'll start climbing stairs but the view is definitely worth it. Be advised it can be very busy, with tons of people so take that into account if you don't like tight spaces or large crowds - it never felt dangerous but…

1850.a: Ala Moana Regional Park, 1201 Ala Moana Blvd, Honolulu, HI 96814
1850.aj: アラ・モアナ市立公園 1201 Ala Moana Blvd, Honolulu, HI 96814 アメリカ合衆国
1850.ed: This 100-acre park with a man-made beach offers usually calm surf, plus tennis courts & a pavilion.
1850.edj: 人工のビーチがある広さ 100 エーカーの公園。波は穏やかな日が多い。テニスコート、休憩所がある。

rv.t: Its close to home and the water is calm. Great place to BBQ swim and watch the fireworks on Friday at 7:45 pm. There's bathrooms there and 2 L&L restaurants to get something to eat. Exercise bars and plenty of room there grass for days. I love it there.

Great walking paths, free parking, restrooms, and tons of outdoor shower stands. Beautiful sunrise and sunset. Gentle waves before the break, great for kids. Can be rocky in certain areas so watch your feet or wear swim shoes. Great surfing waves past the break. Good for stand up paddleboarding! The only thing to watch out for is sometimes there are homeless on the beach, but they generally they won’t bother you.
Very nice walk around the perimeter of the water with views of the ocean, city, and marina. There was one large public restroom. One walk up, "take out" food place with the basics to hold you over.

1851.a: Penny's Waikiki Malasadas, 2233 Kalākaua Ave, Honolulu, HI 96815
1851.aj: ペニーズワイキキマラサダ 2233 Kalākaua Ave, Honolulu, HI 96815 アメリカ合衆国
1851.ed: Diners praise this cafe's delicious and freshly made malasadas, which feature a light and fluffy dough. They also appreciate the friendly service, reasonable prices, and convenient food court location. Some reviews mention the fillings can be runny.

rv.t: Penny’s Malasadas was absolutely delicious! We stopped by based on our tour guide’s recommendation, and that’s always a good sign. If the locals love it, you know it’s worth trying. The malasadas were fresh, warm, and perfectly fluffy with just the right amount of sweetness. It was one of those treats that lived up to the hype. Conveniently located inside the food court at the Royal Hawaiian Center, it makes for an…

These are made freah, we had the filled masaladas, taro, Nutella and original custard. They came out nice and hot, soft and they did not skimp on the creme filling. Its in the royal Hawaiian food court on the 2nd floor. Theres usually a line here during f peak hours. We came at 10am and there was only a 10 min wait.

I wasn't expecting much from a food court in a mall, but these things were delicious. They came straight from the fryer and were loaded with filling. I think these might have been the best malasadas I've had. It took a while to get my order, but I think they were still getting ready for the day. The iced coffee was good too.

1852.a: KCC Farmers’ Market, Parking Lot B, 4303 Diamond Head Rd, Honolulu, HI 96816
1852.aj: KCC ファーマーズ マーケット Parking Lot B, 4303 Diamond Head Rd, Honolulu, HI 96816 アメリカ合衆国
catj: ファーマーズ マーケット
1852.ed: Farmers' market bringing together produce, flowers & local food vendors on Saturdays.
1852.edj: 土曜日に地元の食料品販売業者が集まって市を開催する農産物と花の直売所。

rv.t: It was nice to stroll around KCC farmer's market on a slightly breezy day. The shower trees were in bloom and looking beautiful and proving shade. It was not overly crowded. Beautiful vegetable and fruit to buy. They also had prepared foods to purchases from hamburgers, pasta, tacos and juices etc. There is a lot of park8ng but you will still have a bit of a walk. I had the Acai bwl from LaTour bread which was good…

Gotta thank my sister for this recommendation. The KCC Farmers’ Market is a must visit if you have the time to swing by. Local venders and food. They have takoyaki, fresh drinks, flowers, pickles, and fresh produce. We loved the fresh mochi and takoyaki we got to eat and even enjoyed the cactus garden near by. I’m pretty sure we are stopping by again this weekend for more good food and snacks.

There were so many fresh fruits and delicious food stalls, so it was a really fun experience! You’ll need to check with each vendor to be sure, but there were also plenty of gluten-free food options ☺️ I recommend hiking Diamond Head first thing in the morning, then having breakfast at this farmers market afterward!

rv.t: I visited a looked up and searched for restaurants prior to my trip to Hawaii & I found this one called Waffle and Berry. Since I knew I was going, I decided that Tedy’s Cravings should check it out. We examined the menu and ultimately selected the Waffle and Berry Breakfast Plate, priced at $18. The dish offers a generous portion, featuring soft scrambled eggs topped with savory smoked beef sausage, served…

Berry Fact: A true berry comes from one flower with one ovary. When meeting up with a colleague, she told me firmly, that while acai bowls originated in Brazil, they are a massive staple in Hawaii's food culture and considered a must-try, iconic snack there. Hawaii popularized the version widely found in the USA, adding local toppings like papaya, lilikoi, and macadamia nuts to the frozen blended berry base. And she…

Amazing! My girls and I had 1/2 orders (technically mine was 1/3) and my husband had shrimp and grits. We were all very satisfied with our choices! My GPS directions put us on the wrong side of the shopping plaza. The easier access is off Royal Hawaiian, not Seaside.

1854.a: Ruth's Chris Steak House, Waterfront Plaza, 500 Ala Moana Blvd, Honolulu, HI 96813
1854.aj: ルースズ クリス ステーキハウス Waterfront Plaza, 500 Ala Moana Blvd, Honolulu, HI 96813 アメリカ合衆国

1854.ed: Outpost of upmarket steakhouse chain known for sizzling, butter-topped beef in an elegant setting
1854.edj: 優雅な空間でバターをのせた焼き立てのステーキを楽しめる高級ステーキハウス チェーン。

rv.t: Best birthday dinner ever! I had such a wonderful time here with my family. My husband and son both had a wonderful time here too. The food, the service and atmosphere was amazing. I'm so glad that we got to dined in to celebrate my birthday one day before my actual birthday. Due to the weather condition. My husband did call ahead of time to see if they were still open for business and they were. I can't wait to go…

Phenomenal!!!! From start to finish, our dining experience was outstanding! ALL of the staff was WONDERFUL! Our server, Mel, was nothing short of exemplary. She truly made our visit special. Mel exceeded our expectations with amazing customer service , extreme kindness and constant attention on serving us. Every detail, from the service to the meal, was executed with care and excellence. Perfectly cooked steak/lamb…

It had been awhile since I'd been to a steak house. You know what your going to get and Ruth does it well - nice meat, cooked perfectly (medium-rare), with plenty of butter. I preferred the rib eye and other, non-filet cuts. They do the lobster nicely too. Atmosphere is fine but getting dated, felt the same as 15 years ago.

1855.ed: Diners like this luau's delicious and varied buffet, featuring seafood, prime rib, and a wide dessert selection. They also highlight the captivating performances, live music, and engaging storytelling that offer insight into Hawaiian culture. Guests mention the intimate setting and attentive staff, who provide excellent service and create a welcoming atmosphere.

rv.t: Food 4/5 from Hyatt regency buffet Service for our drinks 5/5, she was great and kept making sure we were good. Ambiance 5/5! Oh my gosh the luau and the performers, the overall show, the ambiance, the feels. 5/5 Even though this isn't at the beach front, it's up on the third floor of a hotel. The staff and dancers, the band, the singers were just amazing, just top tier amazing. We got the VIP package, front table…

My son and I stayed at the Hyatt Regency Waikiki Beach Resort & Spa and figured this would be an easy luau to attend. What a great experience! I was a hula dancer for 20 years and am very picky about luaus. This one felt so special because it's more intimate, has incredible drinks, one of the best buffet dinners, and great entertainment! I highly recommend it!

Wheelchair accessible. Buffet is on the same floor as the performance. You have to navigate between tables of Hyatt Buffet diners, but there is plenty of room. Hosts were very accommodating. Wonderful live music, dancing, and storytelling. Buffet food was 5-star with the Hawaiian and seafood as standouts. Highly recommend! If you go on a Monday or Wednesday, the farmers market is going on downstairs prior to the…

rv.t: Loved the burgers, loved the fries and milkshakes and the yummy sundae. Really cool place to eat and there are some many interesting collectables you can buy in-store, a huge collection. The staff are amazingly friendly and outgoing, I would highly suggest a stop if you are ever in Honolulu.

My family and I ate here tonight and it was amazing. The workers were so sweet and offered to take our photos and got the best angles for us without us asking. Service was friendly and fast. The food was outstanding and truly gave it a classic diner experience and feel. The ice cream sundae is a 10/10 and so are the burgers. We will definitely be back before leaving.

5 stars all around for this place! We were staying around the corner during our first Hawaii visit, and I saw the pictures of this cute little cafe. The pictures don't even do it justice! 旭市にある昭和レトロなお好み焼き屋です。 店内テーマは昭和レトロで一貫されており、さらに各テーブルは小学校や鉄道、ホビーなどそれぞれ趣が異なるため何度来ても楽しめます。 楽しい雰囲気のお店ですが、料理も美味しいです。 お好み焼きやもんじゃは定番メニューから変わったものまで種類が多く、鉄板焼きもあります。駄菓子もあるので懐かしさを楽しめます。 ネット予約ができます。駐車場は店舗横にありますがそれほど広くはありません。 支払いは現金の他にQRコード決済に対応。 初めて連れていく人の反応を見るのも楽しく、おすすめできるお好み焼き屋です。

旭市の鉄板ダイニング楽今に夕食を食べに行きました。入口のドアにタイムマシンと書かれている通り、中は昭和時代にタイムスリップしたような昔懐かしい感覚になれます。昔ながらの看板やアンティークなおもちゃがいたるところに沢山飾られているので、見た目でめちゃくちゃ楽しめます。天井に宇宙の絵が描かれている部屋だったのですが、子どもはそれを見て喜んでいました。 注文はファミコンのリセットボタンが呼び鈴になっているなど、細かい工夫が素晴らしいと思います！ 今回は牛すじ太郎と言うお好み焼きと、もち明太チーズもんじゃ、塩焼きそば、サラダを注文しました。見た目だけでなく、どれもしっかりと美味しかったです！ 沢山の部屋があり、テーブル席、座敷、カウンターと席も様々です。部屋によって内装が違うので、どの部屋に案内されるのかも楽しみの一つだと思います。 駐車場は隣接しておりやや広めの駐車場だと思います。…

rv.t: Had to wait for over an hour after making a reservation at the shop. They called our phone when they were ready. The flavour and variety was worth the wait.

ロイヤルミルクティーと杏仁はちみつレモンを頂きました！ ロイヤルミルクティーにはマサラシロップが付いていて味変できます。 中までしっかり味がついており、高級なロイヤルミルクティーのようでした。 外の杏仁はとろっとしていて、中にはレモンピールが入っており、はちみつレモンの甘酸っぱさが美味しかったです！ 提供までも5分くらいと早く、接客も良かったのでリピしたいと思います！ 平日の14時頃伺いました。 待つことなく入店できました。 お店の場所が少しわかりづらく、通りから1本細い道を入ったところにあります。 すれ違いが出来ないので要注意。 駐車場は広くて良かったです。

1859.ed: Diners like this restaurant's authentic Sanuki-style udon, noting its firm, chewy texture and delicious broth, along with popular toppings like juicy chicken tempura and flavorful fish cake tempura. They also highlight the reasonable prices and the friendly, attentive staff. Guests mention the calm atmosphere and convenient parking, including an overflow lot across the street.
1859.edj: このうどん店を利用した人は、本格的な讃岐うどんを高く評価しています。コシが強くもちもちとした麺と、だしの効いたおいしいつゆが特徴のようです。ジューシーな鶏天や風味豊かな鯛ちくわ天などの人気のトッピングもおすすめとして挙げられています。また、手頃な価格設定や、親切で丁寧なスタッフの対応も評判のようです。落ち着いた雰囲気で食事ができること、そして向かいの駐車場も利用できるため、車でのアクセスも便利というクチコミが多くあります。

rv.t: Food is great. The host is very friendly. Hope next time when I come here I can speak better Japanese.
Wonderful costumer service! Despite a language barrier workers were able to help us navigate how to order our food and gave recommendations. If you are a tourist or local this place is a must go.
The best Udon i had in my life! Everything is freshly made by hand and tastes perfect. The owners are so nice and the atmosphere is perfect. Everyone who reads this must visit. 12/10.
